_about: HIDDEN BRANDS — bookmakers the site owner has asked to hide from the live website completely. Single source of truth. scripts/hide_brands.py strips every brand below from the deploy copy of the site (pages, data files, sitemaps) in deploy_hostinger.yml, right before the upload archive is built; repo source files are never edited, so un-hiding a brand = delete its entry here (and from HIDDEN_BRAND_PATTERNS in assets/shared.js, which --check keeps in sync). 'patterns' are case-insensitive regex fragments matched as whole words; 'domains' lists tracking/redirect hosts that don't contain the brand name itself.
